completion_decisions: Primary problem is the paper-literal 10x10 grid with 200 m pitch; the incompatible continuous-coordinate prose is retained as a sensitivity problem.
The 2015 cited predecessor supplies the ten demes and parameter ranges; the 2016 target-paper population size of 20 takes precedence over the predecessor value 40.
Tournament-2 selection, one-point crossover, one elite per deme, and 20-generation ring migration are deterministic declared reconstructions because neither paper specifies them.
Ambient turbulence is set to 10 percent from the target paper's improved-model field validation because the optimization section omits it.
The inherited 40 m turbine value is interpreted as diameter because the predecessor power equation explicitly uses radius 20 m and the T62 printed free-stream powers require it.
N=38 and N=39 printed fitness cells are recorded as inconsistent; the implementation follows the printed cost and power equations.
missing_information: paper-linked author source and numeric archive
author seeds, final coordinate arrays, and repeat count
ambient turbulence used in the optimization experiment
MPGA selection, crossover form, migration topology, and migration period
explanation for the grid-centre versus continuous 2N-coordinate conflict
explanation for N=38 and N=39 Table-1 fitness inconsistencies

paper.authors: Xiaoxia Gao and Hongxing Yang and Lin Lu
paper.title: Optimization of Wind Turbine Layout Position in a Wind Farm Using a Newly-Developed Two-Dimensional Wake Model

cited_predecessor.title: Wind turbine layout optimization using multi-population genetic algorithm and a case study in Hong Kong offshore

paper_source_conflicts: Target paper specifies both 100 grid-centre sites and continuous 2N 20-bit coordinates.
Eq. (4) uses symbol a for 0.5/log(z/z0), conflicting with axial induction a in Eqs. (1)-(3); it is interpreted as wake-decay k.
Target Fig. 6 specifies population size 20, while the cited predecessor reports 40 individuals.
Predecessor Table 1 calls 40 m a rotor radius, while its Eq. (5) uses 20 m radius.
Target Table 1 N=38 and N=39 fitness cells do not equal COST/printed-power; N=40 does.

scope.claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of the new wake model, native Case (b), and MPGA vehicle; not author-source or author-numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.authority: target paper plus declared deterministic completion
constraints_and_repair.resolution: five-diameter spacing; grid duplicates snap to the nearest unused site in deterministic order

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: primary coordinate decode then 200 m grid-centre snap; separate continuous sensitivity decoder

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: power, COST/power fitness, efficiency; 25 platform seeds because author repeat count is absent

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize nondimensional COST divided by average power; equivalent to maximizing power for fixed N

paper_native_cases.resolution: Case b at 12 m/s over 36 equal directions for N=38,39,40

parameters.authority: target paper then cited predecessor then declared reconstruction
parameters.resolution: ten demes, 20 individuals, crossover 0.7-0.9, mutation 0.001-0.05, one elite, 20-generation ring migration

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: stop after 500 unchanged generations with declared 5000-generation safety ceiling; one complete 36-direction farm evaluation is one physical FES

update_order.resolution: parallel evaluation followed by ordered generation, elite, and migration commits

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: improved Jensen-Gaussian, RSS multiple wakes, 0.3u^3 kW, standard nondimensional cost

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 36 equally weighted directions at 10-degree intervals and constant 12 m/s
